landing.heroTitle:
Your AI-powered guide for smarter
business and financial decisions.
landing.heroSubtitle: FinCompass helps small businesses understand cash flow, pricing, costs, savings and responsible borrowing — using only your consented financial data.
landing.step1Desc: Add your business type and location to get relevant guidance. Optional, anytime.
landing.step2Desc: Record sales, expenses, savings and debt in one place.
landing.step3Desc: Every insight, score and forecast comes with a simple explanation.
landing.step4Desc: Know what you can afford, what to charge, and which schemes may help.
landing.privacyDesc: Only consented data is used. Scores are explainable. Protected characteristics are never used. You can correct your information anytime.

import.title: Import Bank Statement
import.description: Upload a PDF, XLSX, XLS or CSV bank statement. Rows are extracted, categorized and checked for duplicates before anything is saved.
import.dropHint: Drag & drop your statement here, or click to browse
import.privacyNote: Processed securely on the server and never shared or stored.
import.scannedWarning: Scanned (image-only) PDFs cannot be read automatically — use a bank-exported PDF or a CSV/XLSX export.

business.title: Business Profile
business.subtitle: Help FinAI understand your business so advice fits your situation.
business.optionalNote: Everything here is optional. Each detail you add makes recommendations, scheme suggestions and FinAI answers more relevant. You can skip anything.
business.seasonalDesc: Sales mostly happen in certain months of the year
business.phCustomers: e.g. Villagers, daily workers, passing travelers

advisory.title: Business Advisory
advisory.subtitle: Practical guidance for your business, based on your real numbers.
advisory.noTransactionsYet: Not enough data yet. Record your sales and expenses this month to see business health here.
advisory.findingProfitPositive: You kept {amount} of what you earned this month — a healthy sign.
advisory.findingProfitNegative: You spent {amount} more than you earned this month. Look at the biggest categories below.
advisory.findingExpenseChange: Your spending changed by {percent} compared with last month.
advisory.findingConcentration: {category} takes {percent} of your spending — worth reviewing.
advisory.workingCapitalTitle: Working capital you should keep aside
advisory.workingCapitalBody: Keep at least one week of expenses ({amount}) in cash or your bank account so daily purchases never stop.
advisory.reserveMonths: Your savings cover about {months} months of expenses. Aim for 3 months when you can.
advisory.reserveDays: Your savings cover only about {days} days of expenses. Building even a small buffer helps.
advisory.loanCapacityOk: After all costs and EMIs you have {amount} left each month. Any new EMI above this would be risky.
advisory.loanCapacityRisky: Your income does not currently cover your costs and EMIs. Avoid new loans until this improves.
advisory.separateSavingsTitle: Keep business and personal money separate
advisory.separateSavingsBody: Pay yourself a fixed amount each month instead of mixing shop money with household money. This makes profit easy to see.
advisory.phIdeaName: e.g. Tea stall near bus stand
advisory.planAssumptionNote: Use honest estimates. You can update them any time — nothing is saved unless you say so.
advisory.firstMonthCashHint: setup costs + first month of running costs
advisory.breakEvenNA: Add expected revenue above your running cost to see this.
advisory.warningNoMargin: At these numbers the idea loses money every month. Raise revenue, lower costs, or reconsider.
advisory.warningSlowPayback: It takes over a year to recover setup costs. Consider starting smaller.
advisory.estimateDisclaimer: Estimate — your actual numbers may differ.
advisory.pricingAssumptionNote: Overheads are spread across units sold. If you sell fewer units, your true cost per unit rises.
advisory.floorPriceHint: full cost per unit including overhead share
advisory.overheadShareNote: Each unit carries {amount} of your monthly overheads.
advisory.currentSurplusPositive: You currently have about {amount} spare each month after all costs and EMIs.
advisory.currentSurplusNegative: You are currently short by about {amount} each month before any new purchase.
advisory.warningEmiTooHigh: An EMI of {emi} uses most of your {surplus} monthly spare cash. A smaller loan or longer tenure is safer.
advisory.warningNegativeCashflow: Your current cash flow is negative. Fix that first — a new EMI would deepen the gap.
advisory.saveInsteadOption: Saving your current surplus, you could buy it outright in about {count} months without a loan.
advisory.positiveIfRealized: If the extra income is real, you keep about {amount} more each month after the EMI.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your FinCompass preferences and application settings.
settings.generalDesc: Language, currency and timezone are part of your profile and saved to your account.
settings.deviceNote: These preferences are saved on this device. Server-side notification preferences are not available yet.
settings.budgetAlertsDesc: Notify me when my spending approaches or exceeds a budget.
settings.expenseRemindersDesc: Remind me to record expenses so my tracking stays accurate.
settings.savingsRemindersDesc: Remind me about progress toward my savings goals.
settings.cashflowAlertsDesc: Alert me when unusual spending affects my monthly cash flow.
settings.forecastUpdatesDesc: Notify me when cash-flow forecasts are refreshed.
settings.enableFinaiDesc: Allow FinAI to provide financial insights and assistance.
settings.followUpsDesc: Show useful follow-up questions after FinAI responds.
settings.aiDetailDesc: How detailed FinAI's answers should be.
settings.aiFocusDesc: What FinAI should focus on most.
settings.personalizedInsightsDesc: Allow FinAI to use your available financial data to provide more relevant insights. Managed through your consent settings.
settings.manageConsentsDesc: Control which financial data FinCompass may analyze.
settings.dataUsageDesc: Your financial data is used only for the features you consent to: expense tracking, cash-flow analysis, budgets, forecasts and FinAI assistance. Protected characteristics are never used.
settings.deleteAccountDesc: Permanently delete your account and all associated financial data.
settings.deleteTitle: Are you sure you want to delete your account?
settings.deleteWarning: This action is permanent. Your profile, transactions, budgets, goals and all financial data will be erased and cannot be recovered.
settings.changePasswordDesc: Password changes are handled securely via email. Use "Forgot password" on the login screen to set a new password.
settings.logoutDesc: Sign out of FinCompass on this device.
settings.activeSessionsUnavailable: Session management is not available yet.
settings.saveError: Could not save your change. Please try again.
